text:
Maya Chen: Quick triage — we need an intake checklist for the cloud listing across AWS/GCP/Azure. Main gaps: final EULA, hero assets, images/AMI + GCP/ARM artifacts, pricing SKUs, entitlement mapping, and publisher portal access. Who can take which?

Alex Torres: I can own image builds (AMI + GCP images). Need the publisher account IDs and any required bootstrap scripts.

Samir Patel: On KMS/keys: legal asked whether we show BYOK options explicitly. For marketplace listing we typically reference our KMS integration but not require it for trial. Do we have a short blurb?

Carla Nguyen: Legal needs the final EULA PDF and a point of contact for incident reporting (email + pager). Also confirm trademark/logo usage and signed logo release. I can gather templates but need product confirmation on support SLA bullets.

Maya Chen: Thanks. For publisher IDs: AWS: 123456789012, GCP: redwood-marketplace-prod, Azure: redwood-csp-sub we should verify with infra. Alex, expect a link to a bootstrap tar with cloud-init + user-data. Example asset name convention: ```redwood-inference-ami-ubuntu-22-<region>-2026-03```

Alex Torres: Copy. I’ll spin AMIs for x86 and arm64. ETA EOD Tue for AWS images, Wed for GCP. Will post test image IDs here once ready.

Samir Patel: Suggested KMS blurb for listing page: "Optional customer-managed key support available for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys by default." Carla can you OK wording?

Carla Nguyen: That wording looks good. Minor tweak: replace "available for" with "supported in". Also need to confirm retention and export policy line.

MarketplaceBot: Ticket MP-4721 created: "Market listing intake - redwood inference" assigned to partnerships/team. Link: https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-4721

Maya Chen: Packaging/price SKUs — proposal: two SKUs: "RedwoodInference-Standard" (API + hosted) and "RedwoodInference-Dedicated" (reserved capacity). Pricing fields: hourly and monthly commit. We also need trial entitlements (30-day trial token). Thoughts?

Carla Nguyen: Legal ok with SKU names. For trial entitlement we need the trial terms + limits (token cap, rate limit). Product should specify default quotas.

Alex Torres: One operational ask: marketplace test accounts often require a test image with cloud-init that prints a specific file for validation. I’ll include `/etc/marketplace-validation` with a short hash.

Samir Patel: Also confirm telemetry opt-in wording for marketplace listing (we can't send PII). I'll draft short paragraph and share.

Maya Chen: Next steps: Alex build images + post IDs (owner), Carla finalize legal artifacts + EULA link (legal), Samir draft KMS/telemetry blurb (security/compliance). I'll open a workspace doc and upload hero images + logo guidelines. Target: submit intake by Fri COB.

Alex Torres: Roger that.

Carla Nguyen: On it, will upload EULA and logo release today.

Samir Patel: Drafting blurb now, will drop into the doc.

Maya Chen: Tagging follow-up meeting if needed — Thu 9am PT? Reply with + if you can.

Alex Torres: +

Samir Patel: +

Carla Nguyen: +

Maya Chen: Great — thanks everyone.
